recipes.name: Lachha Paratha
recipes.description: Layered spiral flaky paratha tossed with oil and baked in tandoor.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Pleat dough with cooking oil to form 12 crisp spiral layers.
2. Roast in tandoor until golden blistered.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.description: Slow simmered malai paneer cubes in velvety tomato silk gravy.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Sauté organic tomatoes in cooking oil and cashew paste.
2. Add malai paneer cubes and simmer on low flame.

recipes.name: Butter Chicken Old Delhi Style
recipes.description: Charred tandoori chicken cooked in velvety makhani sauce.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Marinate fresh chicken and chargrill.
2. Toss into rich tomato and butter reduction gravy.

recipes.name: Roti
recipes.description: Clay-oven baked whole wheat roti brushed with ghee.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Knead flour with water and oil into smooth dough.
2. Portion into 30g dough balls.
3. Roll thin and bake inside 350°C tandoor for 60 seconds.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka Angara
recipes.description: Marinated cottage cheese chargrilled with aromatic royal spices.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Cut fresh paneer into uniform 35g cubes.
2. Toss in mustard oil and garam masala tandoori marinade.
3. Skewer and roast in tandoor at 320°C for 8 minutes.

ingredients.ingredient_name: Urban Spice Royal Master Garam Masala Blend

recipes.name: Crispy Corn Salt & Pepper
recipes.description: Tender corn kernels tossed with crunchy peppers, scallions, and roasted garlic.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Dust golden corn with seasoned cornstarch.
2. Flash fry until golden crisp.
3. Wok-toss with diced bell peppers, scallions, and crushed pepper.

recipes.name: Murgh Malai Tikka
recipes.description: Succulent chicken tenders in cream cheese, green cardamom, and chili marinade.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Marinate chicken breast chunks in fresh cream, cardamom, and white pepper.
2. Rest for 45 minutes.
3. Chargrill in tandoor until tender with light char edges.

ingredients.ingredient_name: Urban Spice Royal Master Garam Masala Blend

recipes.name: Dal Makhani Slow-Simmered
recipes.description: Whole black lentils simmered overnight on charcoal with churned butter and cream.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Overnight soaked black urad dal & rajma simmered with tomato puree.
2. Whisk in generous cultured butter and cream.
3. Finish with smoked charcoal aroma.

recipes.name: Awadhi Veg Biryani
recipes.description: Fragrant aged basmati layered with spiced vegetables, saffron, and paneer.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Parboil basmati rice with whole spices.
2. Layer spiced vegetables and paneer in handi.
3. Seal with dough and slow cook on dum for 15 minutes.

ingredients.ingredient_name: Urban Spice Royal Master Garam Masala Blend

recipes.name: Hakka Chilli Garlic Noodles
recipes.description: Wok tossed noodles with crunchy julienned veggies and smoked garlic chili sauce.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Boil noodles al dente.
2. Flash wok-sear veggies with garlic chilli soy reduction.
3. Toss noodles over high flame for wok hei.

recipes.name: Paneer Chilli Dry
recipes.description: Crispy cottage cheese tossed with bell peppers, onion petals and dark soy sauce.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Lightly batter and crisp paneer cubes.
2. Sauté capsicum and onion petals in dark soy & chilli glaze.
3. Toss paneer and finish with spring onions.

recipes.name: Margherita Fresca Pizza
recipes.description: San Marzano plum tomato sauce, shredded mozzarella cheese, and fresh basil.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Hand-stretch pizza crust.
2. Spread crushed organic tomato sauce.
3. Layer shredded mozzarella cheese.
4. Bake in stone oven at 320°C for 6 minutes.

recipes.name: Fiery Paneer & Corn Pizza
recipes.description: Tandoori spiced paneer cubes, golden sweet corn, mozzarella, and spicy sauce.
recipes.preparation_instructions:
1. Stretch crust and apply spicy tomato sauce.
2. Top with mozzarella, marinated paneer cubes, and sweet corn.
